review_candidates.title: National Director - WV Ghana
review_candidates.description: Ghana National Director - WV Ghana Organization World Vision Posted 11 Sep 2026 Closing date 14 Oct 2026 With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith. Come join our 33,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories! Here’s Where You Come In GHANA COUNTRY CONTEXT World Vision is a global leader in improving and transforming the lives of children, their families, and their communities. In1979, it expanded its operations to Ghana, a country situated in West Africa, and registered under the name, World Vision Ghana. Ghana has a diverse multiethnic population of over 31 million people, with a majority of the population being of Christian faith. The country also performs relatively well in metrics of healthcare, economic growth, and human development. World Vision Ghana’s head office is based in the capital city, Accra with two additional regional field offices, one based in Accra and the other in Tamale an area in the Northern part of Ghana. The portfolio of programs serves over 40,000 registered children within the various communities; the office operates in 18 Area Programmes and Grant project in 14 out of the 16 regions in Ghana. This is governed by a Board of Directors, whilst its operations are managed by a Senior Leadership team. The office has a staff strength of about 250 employees who are currently supporting the organisation to implement its FY26-30 Operations Strategy aimed at empowering 2.5 million most vulnerable children directly and indirectly with Health and Nutrition, Education and skills development, Water Sanitation and Hygiene as well as food security and livelihood interventions As National Director (ND) , you will strategically lead, develop, and direct the implementation of World Vision Ghana Strategy, in alignment with the Government of Ghana priorities and Our Promise. In performing this role, you will be an effective leader locally, an effective member of the broader WVI Partnership, and will model the organization’s principles of Twin Citizenship to ensure high ministry quality and overall organizational effectiveness. You will contribute to partnership life and unity by acting as both a local and global representative of the organization. You will ensure the country's operations and operating models maintain the Partnership's focus on Child Well Being outcomes and aspirations as they apply in the Ghanaian specific country context, maximizing the impact in the field while maintaining efficiency as wise stewards of entrusted resources. You will lead national resource development, local fundraising, and growth of local resources through effective partnerships with Government of Ghana, the private sector, individual Ghanaians, the Church, and members of WV Ghana. You will also ensure the office collaborates effectively with the WV Ghana Board, other partnership offices, and divisions to achieve local and organizational goals. You will continue to position WV Ghana as a learning centre in the Partnership on localization, while continuing to grow locally restricted funding, including effectively managing locally acquired awards to donor expectations, as well as effectively managing relations with donors locally. Externally, you will foster collaboration with major donors, project partners, local government, church representatives, faith-based organizations, and non-governmental organizations. In doing so, you will maximize stewardship, effectiveness, and efficiency of costs and operating models. You will model a high standard of personal Christian leadership, ministry, and integrity; lead by example; and provide spiritual guidance to staff on the WV Vision, Mission, and Core Values. Requirements Include Master’s degree in development studies, international development, management, administration or social sciences or equivalent At least 12-15 years’ experience in managing effective and efficient operations of a country office or organization, demonstrating sound, people, program, financial management skills and knowledge. (e.g. organizations with over 200 staff and an annual total budget of over $ 20 million) At least 10 years’ experience overseeing and/ or managing a large government grant, its acquisition and donor engagement. Proven track record of leading multi-cultural teams in complex, culturally and politically-sensitive contexts and/or multi-sectoral emergency response projects. Negotiates with purpose and integrity and effectively handles multiple demands from many stakeholders Provides a clear and compelling strategic direction for the organization Experience in fund raising in general and generating local revenue in particular, Advocacy and public relations and overseeing large Government grant; its acquisition and donor engagement Experience in Development and/ Emergency and domestic/ international relief as one of major Ministries (Relief, Development, Advocacy), close familiarity with other two; Is politically astute and shows strong responsible negotiations skills (especially in dealing with politically sensitive government, donors, staff and internal politics) Understanding of country political and socio-economic and cultural context achieved within 3 months after assuming the role Strong information, communication and technology skills and knowledge –ability to use diverse Microsoft applications and management information systems. Travel and/or Work Environment Requirement Domestic Travel: 30% Regular internal travel to project areas is required. International Travel: 15% international travel will be required Office based however some level of travel is expected within the Ghana and to other places. Some travel may be in remote location with minimal facilities How to apply Is this the job for you? Find the full responsibilities and requirements for this position and apply online by the closing date October 14, 2026. World Vision is dedicated to our team members’ development and their success. We aspire for all employees to be fulfilled through their work and their contributions to an organisation working to provide long-term sustainable solutions to the world’s most vulnerable people. For more information on World Vision International, please visit our website: www.wvi.org. Our vision for every child, life in all its fullness. Our prayer for every heart, the will to make it so. review_candidates.title: Manufacturing Technical Engineering Manager
review_candidates.description: Key Responsibilities Technical Engineering & Manufacturing Documentation Provide leadership and technical oversight for Technical Engineering, production documentation, manufacturing data preparation, and SMT programming. Manage, develop, and establish priorities for Technical Engineering and SMT Programming personnel. Establish effective workflows, priorities, accountability, and cross-training within the engineering function. Review and process customer manufacturing documentation and electronic data, including: Bills of Material (BOM) CAD files and drawings Gerber files Pick-and-place/centroid data Assembly instructions Programming and test instructions Customer specifications and engineering requirements Review technical documentation to ensure manufacturing data packages are complete, accurate, and production-ready. Identify missing, conflicting, or incomplete technical information and coordinate resolution with appropriate teams. Manage technical workflow from receipt of customer data through manufacturing release. Prepare, review, release, and maintain manufacturing documentation and instructions. Maintain accurate manufacturing routings, process steps, model points, workflow data, and production information within applicable systems. Support configuration control and ensure production operates using the correct documentation and revisions. Coordinate and implement Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), including updates to BOMs, programs, routings, documentation, and work instructions. Generate and analyze manufacturing reports and data to support production execution and technical accuracy. Support technical reviews, production readiness, and manufacturing schedules. SMT Programming & Process Engineering Provide direct leadership and technical responsibility for SMT programming activities. Manage the creation, validation, release, revision, and maintenance of SMT placement programs. Develop SMT programs using customer-supplied CAD, centroid, Gerber, BOM, drawings, and other manufacturing data. Oversee component locations, rotations, package definitions, reference designators, and placement requirements. Ensure SMT programs are technically reviewed and production-ready before manufacturing release. Coordinate programming priorities with Planning, Manufacturing, Engineering, Program Management, and NPI teams. Establish standardized programming practices, naming conventions, revision controls, verification requirements, and release processes. Maintain SMT component and package libraries, ensuring accurate package definitions and programming data. Optimize placement sequences, feeder setup, nozzle utilization, machine balancing, throughput, and equipment utilization. Support NPI, prototype, first-build, and production-launch activities through timely SMT program development and validation. Provide floor-level technical support during first-article, first-build, and production validation activities. Troubleshoot SMT programming issues, placement defects, component orientation problems, package/library errors, and machine-program issues. Coordinate programming changes resulting from ECOs, component substitutions, customer revisions, and process improvements. Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing setup time, programming time, placement errors, downtime, and production interruptions. Develop and monitor SMT programming performance metrics, including program readiness, accuracy, first-pass performance, defects, and responsiveness. Train, mentor, and cross-train SMT programming personnel to build organizational depth and reduce single-person dependencies. Required Qualifications Direct experience in EMS / PCB / PCBA contract manufacturing is strongly preferred. Strong knowledge of electronics manufacturing and PCBA assembly processes. Strong understanding of SMT manufacturing processes and SMT programming principles. Hands-on experience with SMT placement programming and component/package libraries. Working knowledge of: CAD Gerber files BOMs Centroid/pick-and-place data PCB manufacturing data Component packages and libraries Manufacturing documentation Strong understanding of component identification, package types, polarity, orientation, and reference designators. Experience managing technical personnel and coordinating multiple production requirements. Strong problem-solving, project planning, organizational, and analytical skills. Ability to identify root causes, analyze manufacturing data, and develop practical solutions. Ability to work effectively across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Program Management, Planning, and Supply Chain. Strong attention to detail and commitment to technical accuracy, data integrity, and configuration control. Experience in a high-mix, low-to-medium-volume EMS manufacturing environment is strongly preferred. Education & Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical discipline preferred. Equivalent directly applicable electronics manufacturing and SMT programming experience may be considered. 5+ years of progressive experience in electronics manufacturing, technical engineering, SMT programming, manufacturing engineering, or a related technical function preferred. Previous supervisory or technical team leadership experience strongly preferred. Experience managing a significant engineering/technical organization is highly desirable. Experience supporting complex PCBA products with high component counts and intricate designs is preferred. Experience in a high-mix contract manufacturing environment is highly desirable. Technology Skills SMT programming software and manufacturing data systems. FUJI SMT programming and manufacturing platforms preferred. CAD and Gerber tools/viewers. Aegis MES or comparable manufacturing execution systems. ERP/MRP systems. PLM systems. Microsoft Office and advanced Excel. VBA and ability to modify standard production forms and technical tools. Ability to identify opportunities for automation of repetitive engineering and programming activities. Leadership & Communication Strong ability to communicate technical information to engineers, managers, production employees, customers, and cross-functional teams. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, procedures, and customer documentation. Ability to write clear technical instructions, procedures, correspondence, and manufacturing documentation. Strong leadership, mentoring, prioritization, and team-development skills. Work Environment & Physical Requirements This is a hands-on manufacturing-floor position requiring regular interaction with production operations. Frequently required to stand, walk, sit, use hands, reach, communicate, and work around manufacturing equipment. Frequently lift or move items up to 10 pounds and occasionally up to 25 pounds. Work environment may include moving mechanical parts, fumes or airborne particles, chemicals, vibration, and elevated noise levels. Personal protective equipment may be required in accordance with company safety policies, SDS requirements, and OSHA regulations. Compensation & Relocation Base Salary: $160,000-$180,000 + bonus Relocation Assistance: Up to $10,000 reimbursement Schedule: Monday-Friday, onsite Location: Seymour, Connecticut Relocation assistance is available for the right candidate.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de operationele financiële processen en zorgt ervoor dat transacties correct, volledig en tijdig worden verwerkt. Je draagt actief bij aan het verbeteren van systemen, automatisering en werkwijzen, zodat Finance klaar is voor verdere internationale groei. Jij bent niet op zoek naar een traditionele boekhoudkundige managementrol. Je voelt je thuis in een organisatie waar ambitie hoog ligt en waar verandering eerder de standaard is dan de uitzondering. Optimaliseren van cash conversion en werkkapitaalprocessen. Bewaken van de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van operationele financiële data. Je hebt sterke kennis van operationele financiële processen en ervaring met maand- en jaarafsluitingen. Je beschikt over uitstekende analytische vaardigheden, een sterk procesmatig inzicht en ervaring met ERP-systemen en Excel. Ervaring binnen retail, e-commerce of een internationale, multi-entiteit omgeving is een sterke pré. We ontwikkelen collecties en campagnes die het leven van vrouwen een beetje mooier maken. Met meer dan 1.000 collega’s bouwen we elke dag aan een merk vol ambitie en creativiteit. Onze cultuur? Ondanks onze sterke, internationale groei blijven de lijnen kort, de structuur plat en het saamhorigheidsgevoel op hoog niveau. Als team proberen we iedere dag het verschil te maken!
